title: The Timesheets card shows View and Create & Edit only (no Delete)
custom_preconds: 1. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role).
custom_steps:
1. Scroll to the Timesheets card.
  2. Read the card title.
  3. Read the short description under it.
  4. Read the column headers above the boxes.
custom_expected:
The card title is Timesheets.

The short description reads 'Track and review technician labor hours and time entries.'

There are two columns: View and Create & Edit.

There is no Delete column.
evidence: Timesheets card title + 'Track and review technician labor hours and time entries.' + no Delete column build-verified (PermissionGrid).
